title: Cooperation with the University of Hawaii by state agencies.
bodyText: Every state agency may render services to the University of Hawaii upon the university's request for any purpose related to this subpart.
bodyHtml: [§304A-1967]  Cooperation with the University of Hawaii by state agencies.  Every state agency may render services to the University of Hawaii upon the university's request for any purpose related to this subpart. [L Sp 2021, c 8, pt of §10, §16; am L 2024, c 116, §1]
